name: SHA-256 Hash Generator
summary: Compute the SHA-256 hash of any text instantly and locally.
description: Generate a SHA-256 digest for any UTF-8 text. Useful for checksums, fingerprints and integrity checks. Hashing runs in your browser with no network calls.

faqs.question: Is the hashing done on a server?
faqs.answer: No. The SHA-256 computation runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I use SHA-256 for passwords?
faqs.answer: A plain SHA-256 is not enough for passwords. Use a dedicated password hashing algorithm like bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2 with a salt.

faqs.question: Does it hash files?
faqs.answer: This tool hashes text. File hashing can arrive as a separate tool later.
